description: A two way crossover that splits a stereo pair into low and high bands with fourth order Linkwitz-Riley filters

params.text: Sets the crossover frequency, marked in Hz, from 10Hz upwards
Attenuverts the frequency modulation input, -1 to +1

inputs.text: Modulates the crossover frequency through its attenuverter, 1V per octave at full attenuverter
The left channel to be split; its channel count sets the polyphony of the left outputs
The right channel to be split; its channel count sets the polyphony of the right outputs

outputs.text: The part of the left channel above the crossover frequency
The part of the right channel above the crossover frequency
The part of the left channel below the crossover frequency
The part of the right channel below the crossover frequency

notes: the two bands of a channel sum back to a flat frequency response, so several of these can be chained to make any number of bands
